repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V159-regional-dc-transition-v1'

    assert Path(copy['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copy['public']['path']).read_bytes()

sources=read(prep['sources']['path']);assert ref(prep['sources']['path'])==prep['sources']
assert len(sources['source_texts'])==33 and len(sources['unchanged_neural_hashes'])==87
for path,h in sources['unchanged_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(path)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(path).name)['sha256']==h
    assert ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic'/Path(path).name)['sha256']==h
bundle=read(final['source_bundle']['path']);assert ref(final['source_bundle']['path'])==final['source_bundle']
assert len(bundle['additional_sources'])==12
for item in sources['source_texts']+[sources['publisher']]+bundle['additional_sources']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for path,h in bundle['frozen_postprocess_hashes'].items():assert ref(path)['sha256']==h

def fingerprint(value):
    value=np.ascontiguousarray(value)
    return {'shape':list(value.shape),'dtype':value.dtype.str,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(value.tobytes()).hexdigest()}

outputs=inputs=controls=CPU_loads=events=journal_rows=0;new_paths=set()
for label,c in collections.items():
    assert ref(review['collections'][label]['path'])==review['collections'][label]
    assert c['component_forwards']==822 and c['module_before']==c['module_after'] and c['RNG_unchanged']
    assert c['new_parent_DINO_forwards']==c['new_noise_draws']==0 and ref(c['export']['path'])==c['export']
    arm='sharp-control' if label.startswith('sharp-control') else 'smooth-dc'
    endpoint='EMA' if '-EMA-' in label else 'raw';key='emas' if endpoint=='EMA' else 'models'
    exported=torch.load(c['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    assert exported['parent']==plan['parent'] and exported['paired_training_checkpoint']==training['checkpoint']
    assert exported['arm']==arm and exported['endpoint']==endpoint and exported['step']==1000
    assert equal_tree(exported['state_dict'],checkpoint[key][arm])
    module=classes()[arm](**exported['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(exported['state_dict'],strict=True)
    assert model_hash(module)==c['module_before'] and sum(p.numel() for p in module.parameters())==117677
    CPU_loads+=1;assert [o['id'] for o in c['observations']]==[v['id'] for v in cases]
    old={o['id']:o for o in read(plan['control_collections'][label]['path'])['observations']} if arm=='sharp-control' else {}
    folder=Path(review['collections'][label]['path']).parent
    event_rows=[json.loads(s) for s in (folder/'forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    recorded=[json.loads(s) for s in (folder/'observations-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(event_rows)==len(recorded)==822 and recorded==c['observations']
    assert event_rows==[{'index':n,'id':case['id'],'returned_forwards':n+1} for n,case in enumerate(cases)]
    assert c['forward_journal']==ref(folder/'forward-events-v1.jsonl')
    assert c['observation_journal']==ref(folder/'observations-v1.jsonl')
    events+=len(event_rows);journal_rows+=len(recorded)
    for case,row in zip(cases,c['observations'],strict=True):
        assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
        assert row['parent']==case['parent'] and row['module_forwards']==1
        with np.load(case['arrays']['path']) as arrays:
            for k in ['packed','variance','colors','wb']:assert row['inputs'][k]==fingerprint(arrays[k]);inputs+=1
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction']
        value=np.load(row['prediction']['path']);assert value.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(value).all()
        assert value.shape==np.load(case['parent']['path'],mmap_mode='r').shape and row['values']==fingerprint(value);outputs+=1
        if old:
            assert row['prediction']==old[case['id']]['prediction'] and row['archive_replayed_bit_exact'];controls+=1
        else:
            assert not row['archive_replayed_bit_exact'] and Path(row['prediction']['path']).is_relative_to('/mnt/external')
            assert row['prediction']['path'] not in new_paths;new_paths.add(row['prediction']['path'])
    del module
assert (outputs,inputs,controls,CPU_loads,events,journal_rows,len(new_paths))==(3288,13152,1644,4,3288,3288,1644)

assert fig['native_images']==len(fig['images'])==72 and fig['native_triplets']==24

retained={k:{o['id']:o for o in read(v['path'])['observations']} for k,v in read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json')['retained_native_collections'].items()}
for item in fig['images']:
    assert item['no_resize'] and item['ROI_xywh'][2:]==[160,160]
    assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and ref(item['original_image']['path'])==item['original_image']
    assert item['image']['sha256']==item['original_image']['sha256']
    px=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));assert px.dtype==np.uint8
    for panel in item['panels']:
        x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160 and px[y:y+h,x:x+w].shape==(160,160,3);channels+=w*h*3
    if 'triplet_source_board' in item:

    else:

        for k in retained:
            binding=retained[k][item['case']['id']]['prediction'];assert item['retained_predictions'][k]==binding==ref(binding['path'])
            transformed=anchor+item['contrast']*(np.load(binding['path']).astype(np.float64)-anchor)
            expected=pixels(transformed,a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure'])
            panel=next(p for p in item['panels'] if p['label']==k);x,y,w,h=panel['xywh']
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(px[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected);retained_pixels+=expected.size
assert triplets==24 and channels==fig['RGB_channels_checked']==47078400 and retained_pixels==14745600
view=read(root/'native-viewing-v1.json');assert view['sheets_viewed']==18 and view['primary_figures_covered']==72
assert sorted(n for event in view['events'] for n in event['sheets'])==list(range(18))
assert ref(view['viewing_journal']['path'])==view['viewing_journal']

assert sum(r['kind']=='real' for r in scores['rows'])==30 and scores['real_reference_scores']==0

constant={k for k,c in bycase.items() if c['kind']=='flat' and c['noise']['name']=='adc-only' and c.get('cohort')!='adc-sloped512'}

paired=read(root/'paired-region-comparison-v1.json');assert len(paired['groups'])==88
retained_comparison=read(root/'retained-V156-V157-comparison-v1.json');assert len(retained_comparison['groups'])==40
assert ref(retained_comparison['retained_scores']['path'])==retained_comparison['retained_scores']
old_scores=read(retained_comparison['retained_scores']['path']);old_lookup={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in old_scores['rows']}
pair_counts=[]
for source,baseline_key,base_lookup in [(paired,'baseline',lookup),(retained_comparison,'baseline',old_lookup)]:
    count=0

        assert g['better']==sum(v<0 for v in delta) and g['worse']==sum(v>0 for v in delta) and g['equal']==sum(v==0 for v in delta)
        assert g['maximum_increase']==max(delta)

assert pair_counts==[2176,768]
table=read(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json');assert len(table['cells'])==205
report=(repo/'docs/regional-dc-transition.md').read_text()
for line in table['lines']:assert report.count(line)==1,line
for cell in table['cells']:

    assert len(selected)==1 and abs(Decimal(str(selected[0][cell['field']]))-Decimal(cell['rendered']))<=Decimal(10)**(-cell['digits'])/2

assert (repo/'docs/results/v159-regional-dc-transition-quiet-DC-audit-v1.json').read_bytes()==(root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json').read_bytes()
for r in dc['rows']:
    for f,b in [('DC_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16'),('spatial_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('total_RMS_DN16','quiet_error_RMS_DN16')]:assert abs(r[f]-lookup[r['id'],r['method']][b])<1e-9
    assert abs(r['total_RMS_DN16']**2-r['spatial_RMS_DN16']**2-r['DC_RMS_DN16']**2)<1e-9
dc_lines=[]
for label,method in zip(['V143','V158 sharp raw','V158 sharp EMA','Smooth DC raw','Smooth DC EMA'],['parent','sharp-control-raw-step1000','sharp-control-EMA-step1000','smooth-dc-raw-step1000','smooth-dc-EMA-step1000'],strict=True):
    values=[]

        assert abs(g['mean_DC_RMS_DN16']-np.mean([r['DC_RMS_DN16'] for r in rows]))<1e-12
        values.append(f"{g['mean_DC_RMS_DN16']:.6f}")
    line='|'+label+'|'+'|'.join(values)+'|';assert report.count(line)==1;dc_lines.append(line)
audit=read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')
assert audit['status']=='pass' and audit['rows']==4686 and audit['module_forwards_verified']==3288 and audit['real_rows_unscored']==30
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/regional-dc-transition.md',
    'diary/2026-11-07-02-09-50-v159-dc-transition.md']
docs += [str(p.relative_to(repo)) for p in (repo/'diary').glob('*v159-final*')];assert len(docs)==8

    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):

        target=(p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert target==output or target.is_file(),(name,link);links+=1

report_builder.text:
"""Build the fixed V159 report only after audits and actual native viewing."""

from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V159-regional-dc-transition-v1'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-v1.json')['primary_figures_covered']==72
assert read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json')['recorded_owner_count']==10
audit=read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json');assert audit['status']=='pass'
tables=read(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json')['sections'];dc=read(root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json')
fig=read(root/'figures-v1.json');train=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')
diaries=list((repo/'diary').glob('*v159-final*'));assert len(diaries)==1
protocol=(root/'protocol-document-v1.md').read_text()
formula=protocol.split('## One fixed transition change\n',1)[1].split('## Matched protocol and completed readiness\n',1)[0]
text='''# V159: smoother DC pressure recovers modest coarse correction, with quiet costs

The wider regional-DC transition recovers some correction lost under V158.
Native512 noisy-flat full RMS falls **0.27–0.39% versus V143**, and block32
error falls **0.17–0.19% on average, improving all 48 inputs at both endpoints**.
These coarse gains exceed V158 and V156, while remaining below V157's roughly
0.9–1.0% block32 gain. Quiet total RMS instead rises **0.18–0.48% versus V143**,
with larger regional color bias. Mesh response weakens relative to V158 and
stays below V143/V156. No convincing new fine real cab crossings appear.

Both fresh 1,000-update heads, four fixed raw/EMA endpoints, all 822 cases,
independent audits and all 72 actual native views are complete. Preserve V159
as a modest coarse/quiet compromise: it has much less quiet damage than V157
and stronger standalone coarse correction than V158. Keep V158's better quiet
accuracy, V156's stronger learned detail and V157's stronger standalone-flat
capacity visible. No model here combines their strengths; the general V120
inference choice remains unchanged.

## Standalone noisy flats and surrounding blank fields

All 48 native512 noisy-flat block32 errors improve versus V143, exact V158 and
retained V156 at both endpoints. Full RMS improves on 46/48 raw and all 48 EMA
inputs versus V143; raw's two increases reach 0.000410 DN16. Against V158,
45/48 raw and all 48 EMA inputs improve full RMS. The remaining raw increases
reach 0.011267 DN16. Against V156, full RMS improves on 43/48 raw and 44/48 EMA
inputs. Mean ISO6400 full RMS is 0.14–0.15% below V156; ISO12800 block32 is
0.17–0.19% below it. Broad colored mottle persists despite these small gains.

'''+tables['flat']+'''
Every native512 full/block32 result remains worse than the matched V157 endpoint.
V157's larger correction also carried much larger quiet costs. The independent
retained comparisons verify identical 822 input/parent bindings and parent
metric rows. Their 768 paired entries preserve both improvements and worst
regressions; related CFA placements are not independent scenes.

On present meshes, actual surrounding blank RMS falls 0.38–0.40% versus V143,
and whole present-image RMS falls 0.13–0.14%. Absent-mesh full RMS falls
0.38–0.41%. Added-change RMS is a footprint, not actual blank error or calibrated
hallucination risk. These gains do not imply quiet-neighbor safety.

## Quiet neighbors: spatial improvement, larger color bias

Quiet total RMS rises 0.18–0.48% versus V143 and 0.28–0.57% versus exact V158.
Raw worsens 14/32 inputs versus either parent or V158; EMA worsens 13/32.
Maximum increases versus V143 are 0.219149 DN16 raw / 0.224273 EMA; versus V158,
0.209746 raw / 0.228338 EMA. Whole-scene RMS also rises 0.11–0.16% versus V143.
Quiet spatial RMS improves 0.33–0.55%, so total and spatial error must remain
separate: increased regional bias offsets the spatial gain.

'''+tables['quiet']+'''
Original-pixel reductions check 160 quiet outputs, 480 scalars and every
per-case identity `total² = spatial² + DC²`, maximum scalar difference
1.78e-15 DN16. Mean quiet RGB-bias norms rise 1.25–2.98% versus V143:

| Method | ISO6400 mean quiet DC RMS | ISO12800 mean quiet DC RMS |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
'''
for label,method in zip(['V143','V158 sharp raw','V158 sharp EMA','Smooth DC raw','Smooth DC EMA'],
    ['parent','sharp-control-raw-step1000','sharp-control-EMA-step1000','smooth-dc-raw-step1000','smooth-dc-EMA-step1000'],strict=True):
    values=[next(g['mean_DC_RMS_DN16'] for g in dc['groups'] if g['method']==method and g['prior']==prior) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']]
    text+='|'+label+'|'+'|'.join(f'{v:.6f}' for v in values)+'|\n'
text+='''
Group mean RMS values do not obey the per-case squared identity. Against V156,
raw quiet means change −0.031% at ISO6400 / +0.115% at ISO12800; EMA worsens
0.173–0.396%. Quiet total errors improve on 18/32 raw and 19/32 EMA inputs,
while quiet spatial errors improve on all 32 at both endpoints. Against V157,
mean quiet RMS falls 8.87–12.86%, with 26/32 raw and 25/32 EMA inputs improving.
The large relative gain uses V157's regressed baseline; it is not a comparable
gain over V143. The
[paired-region receipt](results/v159-regional-dc-transition-v1/paired-regions.json),
[retained V156/V157 comparison](results/v159-regional-dc-transition-v1/retained-V156-V157-comparison.json)
and [DC audit](results/v159-regional-dc-transition-v1/quiet-DC-audit.json) retain
all cases and costs. V156 also differs in architecture/DC supervision, V157 in
DC supervision; only the V158 control isolates this transition change.

## Fine mesh, natural detail and ADC

Mesh response falls 1.45–1.89% versus V158 and **2.34–2.83% versus V143**,
reaching only 2.14–2.15% of exact constructed GT. It is 7.97–11.63% below V156,
although 0.69–1.03% above V157. The optional periodic comparator remains
stronger in response, with its documented incomplete orientations, seams,
spill, nonperiodic and runtime limits. Better present/blank RMS does not establish
new wire recovery.

'''+tables['mesh']+'''
Natural faint/dark band response remains 0.20–0.39% below V143, with higher band
error in every group and weaker response than V158. Full error changes are
tiny and mixed: retained faint improves, organic faint/dark regress, retained
dark is effectively unchanged. No convincing new feather barbs or dark branch
texture appear. The reused sources/CFAs do not establish blind generalization.

'''+tables['photo']+'''
All 192 constant ADC controls remain bit-exact parent. The direct spatial path
is exactly zero at zero physical variance, while its jointly trained spectral
path can still change output. ADC-photo mean RMS improves 0.72–0.83% versus
V143, recovering part of V157's gain and remaining weaker than V150's roughly
3.06% gain. This cannot be credited to an active direct ADC output. Sloped-field
full RMS improves 0.71–0.86%, but block32 worsens 3.15–3.78% and worst absolute
DC rises about 0.12–0.13%.

'''+tables['ADC']+'''
## Native 100% comparisons

All 72 primary figures were actually viewed in 18 original-detail sheets.
The [manifest](images/v159-regional-dc-transition-v1/manifest-v1.json) binds
source/ROI, checkpoint SHA256, conditioning, exposure, target anchor and contrast.
Every cell keeps 160×160 original pixels, never resized. All 48 boards retain
four V156 detail / V157 coarse raw/EMA columns without new calls. The boards
and 24 repeated-cell triplets contain **47,078,400 checked RGB channels**.
Repeated cells add no observations.

# V159: wider quadratic pressure on small regional-bias increases

V159 changes only the regional-DC hinge transition on the unchanged V158
hybrid. [V158](regional-dc-regret.md) removed V157's large quiet color-bias
regression, but gave up nearly all of the coarse-flat gain and still weakened
mesh response versus V143/V156. Its 726/882 clipped supervised batches,
compared with V157's 67/882, motivate testing gentler gradients near the parent.
They do not establish that clipping caused the quality tradeoff.

**Implementation and readiness checks pass; quality remains unmeasured.**
Both fixed 1,000-update heads are training. Four final raw/EMA endpoints and
the complete independent/native review are queued. V158 quiet supervision,
V156 detail and V157 spatial/coarse strengths remain useful controls.

## One fixed transition change

The regional RGB mean-error regret `r` is exactly the
[V158 quantity](regional-dc-regret.md#regional-rgb-bias-regret): compare the
three-channel means of output/parent errors against exact training targets,
then take their smoothed vector-norm difference. Native32 boxes/hop16 use the
same replicated boundary grid, nominal units `u=max(s/16,1/65535)` and separate
1-DN16 norm smoothing. Parent, target and units are detached.

For one fixed transition `t`, the positive C1 hinge and its derivative are:

```text
h_t(r) = 0                 r <= 0
         r*r/(2*t)         0 < r < t
         r - t/2           r >= t

h_t'(r) = 0               r <= 0
          r/t             0 < r < t
          1               r >= t
```

| Arm | Regional-DC weight | Transition in regional mean-error units |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `sharp-control` | 1 | 1e−4, exact V158 recipe |
| `smooth-dc` | 1 | 1 |

At regret .1 the new derivative is .1, versus 1 for the sharp control.
At regret at least 1 both derivatives are 1; the absolute hinge values then
differ by a constant. A smaller training loss under the wider hinge is not a
quality result. This is one predeclared constant, with no coefficient/window/
transition sweep or early-checkpoint selection.

One regional mean-error unit is a training proxy. Its physical DN16 size varies
with image noise and has a 1-DN16 floor. It is not calibrated post-demosaic RGB
covariance, a fixed 1-DN16 allowance, confidence or a quiet-safety bound.
Improving parent bias remains unpenalized, and balanced zero-mean detail stays
under the existing RGB/gradient/spectral/full-local losses. A wider soft penalty
can permit larger regional regressions; actual errors and weak detail must be
measured together. No target or independent reference enters inference.

## Matched protocol and completed readiness

The [recipe](../configs/quality-v143-regional-dc-transition-v159.yaml) fixes two
identical fresh `LateSpatialRgbDetail` heads, 117,677 parameters / 45 tensors
each. All 87 neural source files and the loss implementation remain unchanged.
Only the per-arm transition differs. Base pixel/gradient terms, delivered-RGB
spectral MSE .25, local RGB-RMS regret 1, domain weights, initialization,
physical conditions, geometry, LR/AdamW/global clipping/EMA and all clocks are
fixed. Both use the same 1,000 cached V148 batches / 4,000 old observations:
882 supervised and 118 ADC batches with zero total gradient. All 1,000 optimizer
and EMA clocks advance. Production starts fresh after discarded smoke checks.

**60 CPU tests pass in 2.52s**: four new wider-transition cases and 56 inherited
checks. Independent NumPy code enumerates actual replicated/nondivisible box
coordinates, channel means and full pixel adjoints in both quadratic and
saturated regions. Perfect/imperfect parent identity cases verify detached
inputs, zero first derivative and finite second derivatives for the wider hinge.

CUDA compatibility checks 28 archived native256/384/512/768 contexts across all
four CFAs and real controls, 56 actual calls. Current/frozen V158 heads and
archived predictions match exactly. Two discarded ten-update runs include
genuine model/EMA/Adam/RNG save at update8 and restoration for the remaining two.
CPU checks load four states strictly, verify all90 finite Adam states and exact
sharp-control raw/EMA/Adam against V158. All90 parameter tensors receive finite
nonzero prefix gradients. An immutable **40-row production snapshot** matches
every V158 control field. All three original owners were actually observed live
by PID and creation time. This is historical prefix evidence, not completion.

The [preparation publication](results/v159-regional-dc-transition-preparation-v1.json)
preserves 11 byte-exact receipts, 33 source texts and all87 unchanged neural
hashes. The [verification](results/v159-regional-dc-transition-preparation-verification-v1.json)
checks those bytes, actual restored state/prefix and retained comparator bindings.
Final CPU validation must still establish all90 finite Adam states, four strict
loads and the complete1,000-row control trace/raw/EMA/Adam before review claims.

## Fixed full review

All four endpoints use all822 cached cases,3,288 actual head calls. The control
must replay all1,644 V158 outputs exactly before adopting old array storage.

Reused related CFA observations do not establish blind generalization.
